project_identity.design_archetype: The Performance Pro - High Density & Tactical Minimalism

typography.labels: font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8A93A1;

repetition_and_field_proportions.issue: In viewFichaEdit, repetition inputs (min/max), load step (passo de carga), and controls were squished inside a tight 4-column row (.mini-grid), causing truncation and broken layout at 390px.
repetition_and_field_proportions.guideline: Reorganize the exercise edit card into spacious, structured rows or a balanced 2-row responsive grid.

grid_structure.row_1: Séries (1fr) | Faixa de Repetições Mín–Máx (2fr) | Carga kg (1.2fr)
grid_structure.row_2: Descanso segundos (1.5fr) | Passo de Carga kg (1.5fr)

repetition_range_field.container_style: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-width: 0;
repetition_range_field.input_style: flex: 1; min-width: 48px; text-align: center; padding: 10px 6px; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

load_step_field.container_style: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-top: 8px;
load_step_field.input_style: width: 100%; text-align: center; padding: 9px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;

scroll_and_tabbar_isolation.issue: Navigating to 'Dados' or scrolling long sheets caused side scrollbar overlap over #tabbar and visible scroll jumps/sliding artifacts between tab views.
scroll_and_tabbar_isolation.guideline: Isolate the bottom navigation bar (#tabbar) and main scroll container to eliminate scrollbar invasion and transition jitter.

tabbar_rules.position: position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 50;

scroll_rules.main_app: padding: 8px 18px calc(var(--nav-h) + var(--safe-b) + 32px); max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; overflow-x: hidden;
scroll_rules.scrollbar_styling: scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: #242A34 #0A0C0F; ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #0A0C0F; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #242A34; border-radius: 99px; }

navigation_transition.tab_switching: When changing tabs (state.view), instantly reset scroll position using window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }) without animated slides or unwanted ease scroll jumps.

buttons.danger: background: transparent; color: #FC5252; border: 1px solid rgba(252, 82, 82, 0.35);
buttons.touch_target: minimum 42px x 42px for steppers (+/-) and action triggers.

stepper_inputs.container: display: flex; align-items: center; background: #0A0C0F; border: 1px solid #242A34; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;
stepper_inputs.button: width: 38px; height: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #8A93A1; font-size: 1.2rem;
stepper_inputs.input: flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; text-align: center; font-weight: 650; font-size: 15px;

modal_sheet.sheet: background: #13161C; border-top: 1px solid #242A34; border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0; max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto;
modal_sheet.close_button: Every modal sheet MUST include a visible header close button.

testing_attributes.data_testid_rule: All interactive buttons, input fields, selects, tabs, cards, and modal triggers MUST carry unique, role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='plan-item-repmin-0', data-testid='history-filter-select').

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve existing 8 Health dark and red color palette without full rebranding.
Reorganize viewFichaEdit fields into proportional multi-row grids so rep min/max inputs and load step inputs never squish or overflow.
Ensure main content container padding prevents tabbar overlap and custom dark scrollbars do not invade navigation space.
Maintain instant tab switching without sliding or jumping animations when changing state.view.
Verify all interactive controls have data-testid attributes and minimum 42px touch targets.
